Effective Date: [Date]

This Agreement is entered into between [Your Company Name/AquaBlue Innovations] ("Disclosing Party") and [Recipient Name/PineTree Solutions] ("Receiving Party"), collectively referred to as the "Parties".

1. Purpose:
   The Disclosing Party will share confidential information with the Receiving Party for the purpose of [specific project or purpose/potential technological alliance].

   "Confidential Information" includes all non-public, potentially commercially valuable information, specifically:
   a. Software development tactics, processes, and in-house research results
   b. System designs and architectural schematics
   c. Proprietary computational algorithms
   d. Internal software blueprints
   e. Intellectual property awaiting patents
   f. All reports, data, designs, and other materials provided by the Disclosing Party

3. Receiving Party's Obligations:
   The Receiving Party agrees to:
   a. Maintain strict confidentiality using best practices
   b. Use the Confidential Information solely for the disclosed purpose
   c. Not disclose the information without prior written consent
   d. Restrict access to necessary parties, ensuring they abide by strict confidentiality
   e. Return or destroy all confidential information upon request or at the end of the agreement

4. Exclusions:
   Information will not be classified as confidential if it is:
   a. Already known to the Receiving Party
   b. Publicly known
   c. Independently developed by the Receiving Party

5. Non-Competition:
   The Receiving Party will not engage in any competing business against the Disclosing Party during the agreement and one year after its termination.

6. Term and Termination:
   This agreement is valid for [e.g., "two years"], unless terminated earlier with [e.g., "30 days"] written notice. The Receiving Party's non-disclosure and non-competition obligations persist post-termination.

7. Breach and Penalties:
   Breach penalties include injunctive relief, other remedies, and a fee of $295,000 per breach.

8. General Provisions:
   a. Governing Law: This Agreement is governed by the laws of [State].
   b. Amendments: Only valid if written and signed by both parties.
   c. Entire Agreement: This contract supersedes all previous related agreements and contains all related understandings between the Parties.
   d. Successors and Assigns: This Agreement applies to the Parties and their successors and assigns.
   e. Non-Waiver: Lack of enforcement doesn't imply waiver of any provision.

Signed and agreed to by the authorized representatives of the Parties on the Effective Date:

[Your Company Name/AquaBlue Innovations] - Disclosing Party

[Recipient Name/PineTree Solutions] - Receiving Party
